courses.title: 先進封裝共同設計
courses.summary: 以 20 個模組、520 個學習步驟，深入減薄切割、打線、倒裝、扇出、RDL、TSV、混合鍵合、HBM、散熱與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 learning steps cover thinning, singulation, wire bonding, flip-chip, fan-out, RDL, TSV, hybrid bonding, HBM, thermal design and reliability.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學拆解；模組編號是學習順序，製程分支與實際前後關係另有說明。520 步不代表任何廠商的完整量產配方或固定製程數。所有步驟使用明確標示的代表照片；重複使用照片不等於每步專屬實拍。操作為原創概念模擬與工程推理，實驗資料需自行提供或查閱來源。
courses.scopeEn: Educational subdivisions based on public principles. Module numbers describe learning order; process branches and actual dependencies are identified separately. The 520 steps are not a proprietary manufacturing recipe or universal process count. Every step has a labeled representative photograph; reused images are not step-specific process photography. Activities use original concept simulations and engineering reasoning; measured data must be supplied or obtained from sources.

stages.title: 封裝架構、DFM與材料選擇
stages.titleEn: Package architecture, DFM and material selection
stages.description: 以26項獨立教學操作檢查封裝架構、DFM與材料選擇的材料、介面、量測和異常判讀。使用自行建立的示意模型，或您提供／由來源合法取得的量測資料；本課程未附逐工序實測表。門檻須明示為教學假設或來自合格材料文件。
stages.descriptionEn: Twenty-six distinct educational operations review materials, interfaces, metrology and diagnosis for package architecture, dfm and material selection. Use schematic models you create, or measurement data you supply or lawfully obtain from sources. No operation-specific measured tables are bundled. State limits as teaching assumptions or derive them from qualified material documents.
stages.route: 共用架構規劃；選定分支後才建立製程旅行單。
stages.routeEn: Shared architecture planning; select a branch before building a traveler.

steps.title: 辨識封裝功能邊界
steps.objective: 把晶粒、封裝及電路板畫成三個介面區，並能說明「封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護」。
steps.objectiveEn: Draw die, package and PCB as separate interfaces and explain: Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection.
steps.instruction: 把晶粒、封裝及電路板畫成三個介面區。以您自行建立或取得的證據逐項核對：每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色。
steps.instructionEn: Draw die, package and PCB as separate interfaces. Check evidence you create or obtain against: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role.
steps.observation: 每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
steps.observationEn: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
steps.failure: 把板級功能算入晶粒會漏掉封裝介面。
steps.failureEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces.
steps.check: 每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色。
steps.checkEn: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role.

knowledge.title: 本工序機制
knowledge.text: 封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護。
knowledge.textEn: Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection.

knowledge.title: 異常診斷與判讀邊界

steps.failureEn: Missing return grounds overstates signal capacity.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「電源地與訊號對映沒有衝突」。可藉由「把晶粒焊墊網表與中介層接點逐一比對」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Power, ground, and signal mappings have no conflicts. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare die-pad netlists with interposer contacts. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 中介層晶粒腳位對映的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Map die pins onto the interposer
knowledge.text: 鏡射座標錯誤可對接到錯誤網路。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Mirrored coordinates can connect the wrong nets. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「中介層晶粒腳位對映」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Map die pins onto the interposer?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
電源地與訊號對映沒有衝突
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：鏡射座標錯誤可對接到錯誤網路。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Power, ground, and signal mappings have no conflicts
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Mirrored coordinates can connect the wrong nets.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「電源地與訊號對映沒有衝突」。鏡射座標錯誤可對接到錯誤網路，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Power, ground, and signal mappings have no conflicts. Mirrored coordinates can connect the wrong nets, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 矽中介層支線；RDL 中介層與局部矽橋是另類架構，需另選介面與製程。
steps.routeEn: Silicon-interposer branch; RDL interposers and local silicon bridges use different interfaces and flows.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察封裝截面、基板與外部焊球；它不是 TSV／HBM／混合鍵合的專屬截面，也不能判定內部空洞。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe a package cross section, substrate and external balls; it is not a TSV/HBM/hybrid-bond cross section and cannot establish internal voiding.

steps.title: 中介層尺寸與曝光邊界
steps.titleEn: Check interposer size and exposure boundaries
steps.objective: 判斷「中介層尺寸與曝光邊界」是否滿足此具體條件：跨界互連有對應的套準驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Check interposer size and exposure boundaries meets this specific condition: Boundary-crossing interconnects have overlay verification.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：標記拼接邊界及跨界金屬路徑。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Mark stitching boundaries and crossing metal routes. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：跨界互連有對應的套準驗證；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Boundary-crossing interconnects have overlay verification. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 拼接偏移可能在長線形成頸縮。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Stitching offsets can neck long conductors. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 跨界互連有對應的套準驗證；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Boundary-crossing interconnects have overlay verification. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.text: 只看單線損耗會漏掉相鄰干擾。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Single-line loss misses neighboring interference. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「中介層訊號串擾」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Evaluate interposer signal crosstalk?
options: 以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
耦合干擾未超過通道預算
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：只看單線損耗會漏掉相鄰干擾。
optionsEn: Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Coupled interference stays within channel budgets
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Single-line loss misses neighboring interference.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「耦合干擾未超過通道預算」。只看單線損耗會漏掉相鄰干擾，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Coupled interference stays within channel budgets. Single-line loss misses neighboring interference, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 2.5D 整合缺陷關聯
steps.objective: 判斷「2.5D 整合缺陷關聯」是否滿足此具體條件：缺陷定位有跨資料證據支持。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Correlate 2.5D integration defects meets this specific condition: Defect location is supported by multiple data types.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：疊合晶粒位置接合影像及失效網路。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Overlay placement, joint images, and failing nets. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：缺陷定位有跨資料證據支持；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Defect location is supported by multiple data types. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 只靠一張影像可能誤歸因。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: A single image can support a false attribution. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 缺陷定位有跨資料證據支持；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Defect location is supported by multiple data types. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

stages.description: 增層介電、微孔與金屬圖形共同建立多層載板；粗糙度、附著與電損耗具有取捨。本模組為 26 個可分支的判讀作業，課程順序不代表量產配方。網站提供原創示意模型；本模組未隨附逐步實測資料或商用允收門檻。
stages.descriptionEn: Build-up dielectrics, microvias, and metal patterns form multilayer substrates; roughness, adhesion, and electrical loss trade off. These 26 branching interpretation exercises are a learning sequence, not a production recipe. The site supplies original schematic models, not per-step measured datasets or commercial acceptance limits.

尺寸變化可被既定套準策略補償
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.

Dimensional change fits the registration strategy

steps.title: 微孔雷射位置

Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.

steps.title: 晶粒工具潔淨度

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare tool imprints and contamination-transfer maps. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Tools introduce no detectable bond-area contamination. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare tool imprints and contamination-transfer maps. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

stages.title: HBM 與晶粒堆疊組裝
stages.description: 堆疊放大單層缺陷的成本，必須維持晶粒譜系、逐層幾何與測試可達性。本模組為 26 個可分支的判讀作業，課程順序不代表量產配方。網站提供原創示意模型；本模組未隨附逐步實測資料或商用允收門檻。
stages.descriptionEn: Stacking magnifies the cost of individual defects and requires die genealogy, layer geometry, and test access. These 26 branching interpretation exercises are a learning sequence, not a production recipe. The site supplies original schematic models, not per-step measured datasets or commercial acceptance limits.
stages.route: 依產品採微凸塊熱壓、回焊或混合鍵合；本模組比較支線，不宣稱任何供應商固定堆疊配方。
stages.routeEn: Products may use microbump thermocompression, reflow, or hybrid bonding; these are alternatives, not a supplier recipe.

steps.title: 晶粒邊緣機械完整性

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Relate edge chips to TSV keep-out regions. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「材料狀態符合供應商核准要求」。可藉由「比對儲存解凍及可使用時間紀錄」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Material condition meets approved supplier requirements. Evidence can be developed through this action: Compare storage, thaw, and working-time records. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 填膠材料可用狀態的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Check underfill material working state
knowledge.text: 外觀正常仍可能已超出可用時間。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Normal appearance can conceal expired working time. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「填膠材料可用狀態」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Check underfill material working state?
options: 忽略此失效線索：外觀正常仍可能已超出可用時間。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
材料狀態符合供應商核准要求
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
optionsEn: Ignore this failure clue: Normal appearance can conceal expired working time.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Material condition meets approved supplier requirements
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「材料狀態符合供應商核准要求」。外觀正常仍可能已超出可用時間，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Material condition meets approved supplier requirements. Normal appearance can conceal expired working time, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 依封裝選毛細充填、模封充填或預施膠；有蓋、無蓋及液冷介面是替代結構。
steps.routeEn: Select capillary, molded, or preapplied underfill; lidded, lidless, and liquid-cooled interfaces are alternative structures.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察封裝截面、基板與外部焊球；它不是 TSV／HBM／混合鍵合的專屬截面，也不能判定內部空洞。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe a package cross section, substrate and external balls; it is not a TSV/HBM/hybrid-bond cross section and cannot establish internal voiding.

steps.title: 填膠黏度溫度關係
steps.objective: 判斷「填膠黏度溫度關係」是否滿足此具體條件：使用黏度對應實際溫度及剪切條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Interpret underfill viscosity versus temperature meets this specific condition: Viscosity matches actual temperature and shear conditions.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：讀取材料流變曲線並與模型匹配。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Match material rheology curves to the model. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：使用黏度對應實際溫度及剪切條件；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Viscosity matches actual temperature and shear conditions. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 常溫單點黏度不能代表充填流動。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: One room-temperature viscosity cannot represent filling. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 使用黏度對應實際溫度及剪切條件；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Viscosity matches actual temperature and shear conditions. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：前緣到達遠端且未留未填區；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 可見邊緣濕潤不代表底部已充滿。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Visible edge wetting does not prove complete bottom filling. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 前緣到達遠端且未留未填區；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.title: 晶粒邊緣膠前緣的驗證依據

knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「前緣到達遠端且未留未填區」。可藉由「讀取透明模型的時間序列」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions. Evidence can be developed through this action: Read time-series images from the transparent model. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 晶粒邊緣膠前緣的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Track the die-edge underfill front
knowledge.text: 可見邊緣濕潤不代表底部已充滿。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Visible edge wetting does not prove complete bottom filling. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「晶粒邊緣膠前緣」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？

options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。

以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
前緣到達遠端且未留未填區
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Visible edge wetting does not prove complete bottom filling.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Front reaches the far side without unfilled regions

knowledge.text: 只看總塗佈量會漏掉熱點缺膠。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Total deposited mass can hide uncovered hotspots. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「導熱層塗佈覆蓋」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Inspect thermal-interface coverage?
options: 目標熱區連續覆蓋且不污染保留區
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：只看總塗佈量會漏掉熱點缺膠。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Hot regions are covered without contaminating keep-outs
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Total deposited mass can hide uncovered hotspots.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「目標熱區連續覆蓋且不污染保留區」。只看總塗佈量會漏掉熱點缺膠，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Hot regions are covered without contaminating keep-outs. Total deposited mass can hide uncovered hotspots, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 依封裝選毛細充填、模封充填或預施膠；有蓋、無蓋及液冷介面是替代結構。
steps.routeEn: Select capillary, molded, or preapplied underfill; lidded, lidless, and liquid-cooled interfaces are alternative structures.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察封裝截面、基板與外部焊球；它不是 TSV／HBM／混合鍵合的專屬截面，也不能判定內部空洞。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe a package cross section, substrate and external balls; it is not a TSV/HBM/hybrid-bond cross section and cannot establish internal voiding.

steps.title: 導熱層厚度控制
steps.objective: 判斷「導熱層厚度控制」是否滿足此具體條件：厚度與接觸壓力均在材料工作窗內。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Control thermal-interface thickness meets this specific condition: Thickness and pressure meet material operating windows.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：以支撐幾何推算壓合後厚度。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Infer compressed thickness from support geometry. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：厚度與接觸壓力均在材料工作窗內；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Thickness and pressure meet material operating windows. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 過薄層可能無法吸收翹曲間隙。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: An overly thin layer may not accommodate warpage gaps. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 厚度與接觸壓力均在材料工作窗內；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Thickness and pressure meet material operating windows. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Thickness and pressure meet material operating windows. Evidence can be developed through this action: Infer compressed thickness from support geometry. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

steps.title: 焊球橋接判讀

knowledge.text: 不計電流擁擠會低估局部應力。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring current crowding underestimates local stress. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「導體電遷移評估」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Assess conductor electromigration?
options: 失效判據與受測導體截面明確
只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：不計電流擁擠會低估局部應力。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
optionsEn: Failure criteria and conductor cross sections are explicit
Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Ignoring current crowding underestimates local stress.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
quiz.explanation: 應確認「失效判據與受測導體截面明確」。不計電流擁擠會低估局部應力，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Failure criteria and conductor cross sections are explicit. Ignoring current crowding underestimates local stress, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.route: 可靠度評估為抽樣與破壞性分析支線，並非所有成品都依次接受所有應力試驗；條件依適用規格訂定。
steps.routeEn: Reliability uses sampling and destructive-analysis branches; not every unit receives every stress test, and conditions follow the applicable specification.

steps.title: 介電時間依賴失效
steps.objective: 判斷「介電時間依賴失效」是否滿足此具體條件：介電受力與電極幾何均可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Assess time-dependent dielectric failure meets this specific condition: Dielectric stress and electrode geometry are traceable.
steps.instruction: 以示意模型練習，並在需要量測時使用你自行提供或從所列來源取得的可用資料：分析偏壓下漏電與失效時間。保存資料來源與樣本識別；依有來源的設計或材料規範判讀。缺少資料或門檻時標記待驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Analyze leakage and failure times under bias. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：介電受力與電極幾何均可追溯；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Dielectric stress and electrode geometry are traceable. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 接觸短路不能誤歸為介電崩潰。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: Contact shorts must not be mislabeled dielectric breakdown. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 介電受力與電極幾何均可追溯；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Dielectric stress and electrode geometry are traceable. Submit the image, curve, or record supporting the judgment.

Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Failing addresses and test revisions are traceable. Evidence can be developed through this action: Map scan failures to physical dies. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 掃描鏈測試對映的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Map scan-chain failures
knowledge.text: 錯用測試版本可能造成全面假失敗。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong test revisions can cause widespread false failures. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 完成「掃描鏈測試對映」時，哪項證據最直接支持通過？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports passing Map scan-chain failures?
options: 只完成操作或讀入影像，尚未檢查其是否符合判準。
忽略此失效線索：錯用測試版本可能造成全面假失敗。
以全批平均值取代這一步所需的局部或個別證據。
失效位址與測試版本可追溯
optionsEn: Complete the action or load the image without checking the criterion.
Ignore this failure clue: Wrong test revisions can cause widespread false failures.
Replace the required local or individual evidence with a lot average.
Failing addresses and test revisions are traceable
quiz.explanation: 應確認「失效位址與測試版本可追溯」。錯用測試版本可能造成全面假失敗，因此僅完成操作或忽略局部異常不能作為通過依據。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm: Failing addresses and test revisions are traceable. Wrong test revisions can cause widespread false failures, so performing the action or ignoring local anomalies cannot establish a pass.

steps.title: 記憶體功能圖樣
steps.objective: 判斷「記憶體功能圖樣」是否滿足此具體條件：目標故障類別都有可追溯測試。

steps.instructionEn: Practice with the schematic model and, where measurements are needed, use data you supply or obtain from the listed sources: Compare address, data, and retention-test coverage. Preserve provenance and specimen identity, and use documented design or material criteria. Mark the result unverified when data or limits are missing.
steps.observation: 觀察重點：目標故障類別都有可追溯測試；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
steps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Target fault classes have traceable tests. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
steps.failure: 單一讀寫圖樣不能覆蓋所有記憶體故障。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
steps.failureEn: One read-write pattern cannot cover all memory faults. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
steps.check: 目標故障類別都有可追溯測試；提交與判斷相符的圖、曲線或紀錄。

options: 固化收縮及材料熱膨脹可使對位在固定後改變。

courses.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合
courses.summary: 以介電層與銅接墊的共同界面，理解平坦化、清潔、對位、接合及電性可靠度之間的依賴。
courses.summaryEn: Follow a shared dielectric-and-copper interface through planarization, cleaning, alignment, bonding and electrical reliability.

stages.title: 界面與版圖
stages.description: 先界定成對晶圓、接點與驗證結構。
stages.descriptionEn: Define the paired wafers, contacts and verification structures.

steps.title: 界定混合接合的兩種功能
steps.titleEn: Define the two functions of hybrid bonding
steps.objective: 區別介電層支撐與金屬導通。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish dielectric attachment from metal conduction.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩片面對面的截面，將介電層接觸與銅接墊接觸分色。追蹤一條訊號跨越界面的路徑，指出哪些位置負責支撐、哪些位置必須導通。
steps.instructionEn: Draw face-to-face sections and color dielectric and copper contacts separately. Trace one signal across the interface, identifying mechanical attachment and required electrical continuity.
steps.observation: 整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
steps.observationEn: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.
steps.failure: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
steps.failureEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.
steps.check: 分別指定機械接合與電性接點的驗證方法。
steps.checkEn: Assign separate verification approaches to attachment and electrical contacts.

knowledge.title: 雙重界面
knowledge.text: 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
knowledge.textEn: Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

knowledge.title: 功能分驗
knowledge.text: 機械完整與電性導通互相關聯，但不能互相替代驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical integrity and electrical continuity are related but need separate evidence.

quiz.question: 看見整片沒有分離，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does observing that the wafers remain attached establish?
options: 提供機械貼合的部分證據，仍須電性驗證。
介電貼合強度已足以代表所有接觸電阻。
只要外圓重合，就證明每一接墊的隔離合格。
optionsEn: It provides some attachment evidence; electrical verification remains necessary.
Dielectric attachment strength fully represents every contact resistance.
Overlapping outlines prove isolation of every pad.
quiz.explanation: 提供機械貼合的部分證據，仍須電性驗證。 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
quiz.explanationEn: It provides some attachment evidence; electrical verification remains necessary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

steps.title: 核對成對晶圓的版圖與方位
steps.objective: 避免面對面翻轉造成接點配對錯誤。
steps.objectiveEn: Prevent contact mismatches caused by face-to-face reversal.
steps.instruction: 在透明紙或繪圖軟體畫兩片含不對稱記號的晶圓。將上片翻面，逐一對應接墊與方向標記，再比較旋轉與鏡射的差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two wafers with asymmetric marks on transparent sheets or in drawing software. Flip the upper wafer and match pads and orientation marks, comparing rotation with reflection.
steps.observation: 對稱圖案可能掩蓋翻面錯誤，因此保留不對稱檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Symmetric patterns can hide a reversal error, so retain an asymmetric check.
steps.failure: 只對齊外圓卻錯配接墊時，應回到座標轉換，而非微調所有接點。
steps.failureEn: If wafer outlines align but pads mismatch, revisit coordinate transforms rather than adjust every contact.
steps.check: 用三個非共線標記驗證方向，並說明翻面後的接點對應。
steps.checkEn: Verify orientation with three non-collinear marks and explain pad correspondence after flipping.

knowledge.title: 座標轉換
knowledge.text: 面對面接合需要一致的翻面、旋轉與位移定義。
knowledge.textEn: Face-to-face bonding needs consistent definitions of reflection, rotation and translation.

knowledge.title: 不對稱標記
knowledge.text: 不對稱資訊能區分看似相同的錯誤方位。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric information distinguishes otherwise similar incorrect orientations.

quiz.question: 外圓重合但不對稱標記相反，優先檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Outlines overlap but asymmetric marks reverse. What should be checked first?
options: 只調整同一平移量，不檢查是否鏡射。
翻面與座標對應規則。
只看晶圓外圓，因為圖案方位不影響接點對應。
optionsEn: Apply one translation without checking for reflection.
The flip and coordinate-mapping rules.
Inspect the wafer outline only, assuming pattern orientation cannot affect matching.
quiz.explanation: 翻面與座標對應規則。 面對面接合需要一致的翻面、旋轉與位移定義。
quiz.explanationEn: The flip and coordinate-mapping rules. Face-to-face bonding needs consistent definitions of reflection, rotation and translation.

steps.title: 比較接墊尺寸與容許偏移
steps.titleEn: Compare pad size and overlay allowance
steps.objective: 理解接觸重疊與相鄰間距的共同限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand joint limits from contact overlap and neighbor spacing.
steps.instruction: 畫一組等尺寸接墊與一組上下不同尺寸接墊，逐次平移上層透明圖。記錄何時重疊不足或接近鄰點；所有尺寸自行假設，不能套用為製造規格。
steps.instructionEn: Draw equal-size and unequal-size pad pairs and translate the upper overlay. Record loss of overlap or approach to a neighbor; label all dimensions hypothetical, not manufacturing specifications.
steps.observation: 增加接墊大小可改善部分重疊，但也會改變相鄰間距。
steps.observationEn: Enlarging a pad can improve overlap while changing neighbor clearance.
steps.failure: 只最大化重疊而忽略鄰近接點，可能隱藏短路或介電風險。
steps.failureEn: Maximizing overlap while ignoring neighbors can conceal shorting or dielectric risk.
steps.check: 同時呈現重疊與間距兩項判據，並指出適用的偏移方向。
steps.checkEn: Show both overlap and clearance criteria and identify the displacement directions considered.

knowledge.title: 版圖容差
knowledge.text: 接墊形狀與相對尺寸會改變對位誤差的容忍度。
knowledge.textEn: Pad geometry and relative size affect tolerance to alignment error.

knowledge.title: 局部代價
knowledge.text: 幾何上的改良須連同鄰點間距和電性一起評估。
knowledge.textEn: A geometric improvement must be assessed with neighbor spacing and electrical behavior.

quiz.question: 為何不能無限制放大所有接墊？
quiz.questionEn: Why not enlarge every pad without limit?
options: 接墊加大只會改善重疊，不影響鄰近間距。
只要銅面積增加，就不需考慮介電隔離。
重疊改善可能消耗鄰點間距。
optionsEn: Enlarging pads improves overlap without affecting neighbor spacing.
More copper area removes the need to consider dielectric isolation.
Improved overlap can consume neighbor clearance.
quiz.explanation: 重疊改善可能消耗鄰點間距。 接墊形狀與相對尺寸會改變對位誤差的容忍度。
quiz.explanationEn: Improved overlap can consume neighbor clearance. Pad geometry and relative size affect tolerance to alignment error.

steps.title: 配置串鏈與隔離測試結構
steps.titleEn: Plan chain and isolation test structures
steps.objective: 讓開路與相鄰漏電能被分開發現。
steps.objectiveEn: Make opens and neighbor leakage separately observable.
steps.instruction: 在示意版圖串接多個跨界面接點，另畫相鄰但不相連的導體。預測單一開路、接觸電阻增加及鄰點短路，各會改變哪項測試結果。
steps.instructionEn: Chain multiple cross-interface contacts in a schematic and draw separate adjacent conductors. Predict which measurements change for an open, higher contact resistance or a neighbor short.
steps.observation: 串鏈只顯示累積路徑，未必能定位單一異常接點。
steps.observationEn: A chain exposes a cumulative path but may not localize one defective contact.
steps.failure: 把低串鏈電阻當作隔離合格會漏掉另一種故障；保留獨立隔離判據。
steps.failureEn: Treating low chain resistance as proof of isolation misses another failure class; retain a separate criterion.
steps.check: 建立故障、測試結構與可見現象的三欄對照。
steps.checkEn: Map each fault to a test structure and observable response.

knowledge.title: 可觀測性
knowledge.text: 測試結構必須讓想找的失效改變可讀取的量。
knowledge.textEn: A test structure must make the targeted failure affect an observable quantity.

knowledge.title: 累積與定位
knowledge.text: 整條串鏈的結果與單一接點的結果具有不同解析度。
knowledge.textEn: Whole-chain and individual-contact results have different diagnostic resolution.

quiz.question: 串鏈可導通，還需要哪類補充證據？
quiz.questionEn: A chain conducts. What complementary evidence is still useful?
options: 相鄰導體的隔離與漏電檢查。
只重複同一串鏈讀值，不需要不同測試結構。
只檢查機械接合強度便能排除相鄰短路。
optionsEn: Isolation and leakage checks between neighboring conductors.
Repeat the same chain reading; different test structures are unnecessary.
Mechanical bond strength alone rules out neighbor shorts.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰導體的隔離與漏電檢查。 測試結構必須讓想找的失效改變可讀取的量。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation and leakage checks between neighboring conductors. A test structure must make the targeted failure affect an observable quantity.

stages.title: 表面與對位
stages.description: 區分表面幾何、表面狀態與面內對位的限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate limits from surface geometry, surface condition and in-plane alignment.

steps.title: 判讀 CMP 後的銅凹陷與介電平坦度
steps.titleEn: Interpret copper recess and dielectric flatness
steps.objective: 分開比較銅高度與介電面形貌。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare copper height separately from dielectric topography.
steps.instruction: 畫出銅突出、合適凹陷及過深凹陷三種假想截面，標出首先接觸的位置。比較它們對介電貼合與後續金屬連接的影響，不設定通用奈米公差。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hypothetical protruding, appropriately recessed and deeply recessed copper sections. Mark first-contact locations and compare dielectric attachment and later metal connection without assigning universal nanometer tolerances.
steps.observation: 全片平均平坦仍可能掩蓋某些接墊的局部高度問題。
steps.observationEn: Good average flatness can still hide local pad-height problems.
steps.failure: 把所有材料畫成完全齊平，可能遺失研究流程所需的受控凹陷；回查來源路線。
steps.failureEn: Drawing every material perfectly flush can erase the controlled recess required by the referenced route; review its assumptions.
steps.check: 說明三種截面的不同風險，且將量產公差保留為待查規格。
steps.checkEn: Explain the distinct risks and leave production tolerances as requirements to obtain.

knowledge.title: 受控形貌
knowledge.text: 接合前形貌須同時配合介電接觸及後續銅連接。
knowledge.textEn: Prebond topography must accommodate both dielectric contact and subsequent copper connection.

knowledge.title: 局部高度
knowledge.text: 銅凹陷相對於鄰近介電面定義，不能只看晶圓平均厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Copper recess is relative to nearby dielectric, not merely average wafer thickness.

quiz.question: 銅凹陷應相對於哪個基準判讀？
quiz.questionEn: What reference defines copper recess?
options: 整片晶圓背面的平均平面。
相鄰介電表面。
尚未拋光前的總銅沉積厚度。
optionsEn: The average plane of the wafer backside.
The adjacent dielectric surface.
Total copper thickness before polishing.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰介電表面。 接合前形貌須同時配合介電接觸及後續銅連接。
quiz.explanationEn: The adjacent dielectric surface. Prebond topography must accommodate both dielectric contact and subsequent copper connection.

steps.title: 追溯清潔、活化與等待時間
steps.objective: 將表面狀態與後續接合條件連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect surface condition to subsequent bonding conditions.
steps.instruction: 建立清潔、表面活化、等待與接合的時間線，為兩條假設路徑標記暴露及搬運點。比較粒子控制與活化目的，不推定兩者可互相取代。
steps.instructionEn: Build timelines for cleaning, activation, waiting and bonding, marking exposure and handling in two hypothetical routes. Compare particle control with activation without treating them as interchangeable.
steps.observation: 兩片幾何相同的表面，仍可能因狀態或污染不同而表現不同。
steps.observationEn: Geometrically similar surfaces can behave differently because of condition or contamination.
steps.failure: 缺少交接時間紀錄時，不能把不良全歸因於對位。
steps.failureEn: Without handoff timing records, do not attribute all failures to overlay.
steps.check: 時間線包含每次表面暴露與可追溯的狀態紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Include each exposure and a traceable surface-condition record.

knowledge.title: 表面功能
knowledge.text: 介電層直接接合依賴適當的表面狀態，不只是兩片相碰。
knowledge.textEn: Direct dielectric bonding depends on suitable surface condition, not merely physical contact.

knowledge.title: 交接窗口
knowledge.text: 等待和搬運也是流程條件，應與清潔及活化一起記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Waiting and handling are process conditions that belong with cleaning and activation records.

quiz.question: 活化後延長等待，為何仍需重新核對接合條件？
quiz.questionEn: Why review bonding conditions after a longer post-activation wait?
options: 只要對位精度相同，表面暴露時間就不影響判定。
等待越久必然接合越強，不需檢查表面狀態。
表面狀態和暴露歷程可能改變。
optionsEn: Equal overlay accuracy makes surface-exposure time irrelevant.
A longer wait always strengthens bonding without checking surface condition.
Surface condition and exposure history may change.
quiz.explanation: 表面狀態和暴露歷程可能改變。 介電層直接接合依賴適當的表面狀態，不只是兩片相碰。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface condition and exposure history may change. Direct dielectric bonding depends on suitable surface condition, not merely physical contact.

steps.title: 分離平移、旋轉與變形誤差
steps.objective: 用多位置標記判斷對位誤差模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Diagnose overlay-error patterns from multiple marks.
steps.instruction: 在中心與四個外圍位置畫誤差箭頭，分別建立同向、繞中心旋轉及局部不規則三個案例。嘗試以一個平移修正各案例，觀察哪些殘差無法消除。
steps.instructionEn: Draw overlay vectors at the center and four outer positions for translation, rotation and irregular local distortion. Apply one translation correction to each and identify residuals it cannot remove.
steps.observation: 中心對好仍可能在邊緣有旋轉或形變殘差。
steps.observationEn: Good center alignment can coexist with rotational or distortion residuals at the edge.
steps.failure: 只用單一標記決定全片合格會忽略誤差模式；增加空間取樣。
steps.failureEn: One-mark acceptance overlooks error structure; add spatial sampling.
steps.check: 將每種誤差對應到可修正部分與待調查部分。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish correctable components from residuals requiring investigation.

knowledge.title: 誤差場
knowledge.text: 對位是一個空間分布，不只是單一偏移值。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay is a spatial field, not just one offset.

knowledge.title: 剛體限制
knowledge.text: 平移與旋轉不能完全補償所有局部變形。
knowledge.textEn: Translation and rotation cannot fully compensate every local distortion.

quiz.question: 平移後中心已對齊但邊緣仍繞中心偏轉，較像哪種誤差？
quiz.questionEn: Translation fixes the center but edge vectors remain rotational. What does this suggest?
options: 仍有旋轉分量。
單純固定方向的平移，中心結果足以代表全片。
一定是所有接墊同等加寬，無需檢查對位模型。
optionsEn: A remaining rotational component.
Pure fixed-direction translation, with center results representing the entire wafer.
Every pad must have widened equally, requiring no alignment-model review.
quiz.explanation: 仍有旋轉分量。 對位是一個空間分布，不只是單一偏移值。
quiz.explanationEn: A remaining rotational component. Overlay is a spatial field, not just one offset.

steps.title: 規劃接合前的雙面放行
steps.objective: 防止只檢查其中一片晶圓。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid checking only one member of the wafer pair.
steps.instruction: 為上下晶圓各建一張表，列出身分、方位、形貌、污染與等待歷程。挑選一項缺失資料，討論它如何影響整對晶圓的放行，而非以另一片的結果補值。
steps.instructionEn: Make separate records for wafer identity, orientation, topography, contamination and waiting history. Remove one item and explain how that affects pair release rather than substituting the other wafer’s result.
steps.observation: 接合是成對事件，單片合格不等於配對與界面均合格。
steps.observationEn: Bonding is a paired event; one acceptable wafer does not prove a valid pair or interface.
steps.failure: 批次或方位配對錯誤不能靠後段退火修正。
steps.failureEn: Annealing cannot repair an incorrect lot or orientation pairing.
steps.check: 放行表可從接合批次追溯到兩片來料及各自量測。
steps.checkEn: Trace the bonded lot to both incoming wafers and their individual measurements.

knowledge.title: 配對追溯
knowledge.text: 兩側輸入共同決定接合界面品質。
knowledge.textEn: Both inputs jointly determine interface quality.

knowledge.title: 缺值處理
knowledge.text: 另一片的好結果不能補足本片缺少的證據。
knowledge.textEn: A good result from one wafer cannot fill an evidence gap for the other.

quiz.question: 上片形貌合格、下片未量測，正確結論為何？
quiz.questionEn: The upper wafer passes topography checks but the lower is unmeasured. What follows?
options: 下片可沿用上片結果，因為兩片目標規格相同。
整對晶圓仍待驗證。
對位設備型號相同，就不需要下片形貌證據。
optionsEn: The lower wafer can inherit the upper result because target specifications match.
The pair remains unverified.
The same aligner model removes the need for lower-wafer topography evidence.
quiz.explanation: 整對晶圓仍待驗證。 兩側輸入共同決定接合界面品質。
quiz.explanationEn: The pair remains unverified. Both inputs jointly determine interface quality.

stages.title: 接合與驗證
stages.description: 結合機械、空洞與電性證據，避免只用外觀判定接合成功。
stages.descriptionEn: Combine mechanical, void and electrical evidence rather than judge a bond by appearance.

steps.title: 觀察接合波與未接合區域
steps.titleEn: Observe the bond wave and unbonded regions
steps.objective: 把接觸傳播與空洞證據連結。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate contact propagation to void evidence.
steps.instruction: 在原創示意圖畫出由起始接觸點擴展的接合前緣，再加入一個粒子與一個局部形貌障礙。預測可能留下的未接合區，與來源影像中的觀察方法比較。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an original bond front spreading from initial contact, then add one particle and one local topographic obstacle. Predict unbonded regions and compare the observation approach with referenced imagery.
steps.observation: 前緣通過與界面完全無空洞是不同判斷。
steps.observationEn: Passage of a bond front is not the same conclusion as a void-free interface.
steps.failure: 若只保存最終外觀，可能缺少判斷缺陷起源的時間資訊。
steps.failureEn: Keeping only the final appearance may lose timing needed to diagnose defect origins.
steps.check: 標記預測區域、可檢查的方法及不能由示意圖證明的部分。
steps.checkEn: Mark predicted regions, an inspection approach and what the schematic cannot prove.

knowledge.title: 接觸傳播
knowledge.text: 表面接觸可沿界面擴展，局部障礙會影響完整貼合。
knowledge.textEn: Contact can propagate along the interface, while local obstacles affect complete attachment.

knowledge.title: 空洞定位
knowledge.text: 缺陷位置需與前處理和形貌紀錄交叉比較。
knowledge.textEn: Defect locations should be compared with preparation and topography records.

quiz.question: 模型顯示接合前緣已到邊緣，仍需檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: The modeled bond front reaches the edge. What still needs checking?
options: 只需確認接觸前緣速度，無需檢查內部區域。
只量測外圓厚度，就可取代界面檢查。
界面內是否殘留未接合區。
optionsEn: Only bond-front speed needs checking, not interior regions.
Edge thickness alone replaces interface inspection.
Whether unbonded regions remain inside the interface.
quiz.explanation: 界面內是否殘留未接合區。 表面接觸可沿界面擴展，局部障礙會影響完整貼合。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether unbonded regions remain inside the interface. Contact can propagate along the interface, while local obstacles affect complete attachment.

steps.title: 判讀退火對介電層與銅連接的作用
steps.titleEn: Interpret annealing of dielectric and copper bonds
steps.objective: 區分初始貼合與後續接合強化。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish initial attachment from subsequent bond strengthening.
steps.instruction: 用前後兩張截面圖標出預接合與退火後狀態，分別追蹤介電界面及銅接點。列出需向實際製程取得的熱預算與材料相容性資料，不填入通用溫度配方。
steps.instructionEn: Compare prebond and post-anneal sections, following dielectric interfaces and copper contacts separately. List thermal-budget and compatibility information needed from the actual process without inventing a universal temperature recipe.
steps.observation: 某條研究路線的可用條件不代表所有介電材料與金屬堆疊皆適用。
steps.observationEn: Conditions demonstrated for one research route do not apply automatically to every dielectric and metal stack.
steps.failure: 用提高溫度補償未知污染，可能增加其他損害而未處理根因。
steps.failureEn: Raising temperature to compensate for unknown contamination may add damage without addressing the cause.
steps.check: 說明退火前後需要不同證據，並保留產品熱限制。
steps.checkEn: Explain the evidence needed before and after annealing and retain product thermal constraints.

knowledge.title: 接合演變
knowledge.text: 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
knowledge.textEn: Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

knowledge.title: 熱預算相容性
knowledge.text: 接合條件須與先前完成的元件和互連相容。
knowledge.textEn: Bonding conditions must remain compatible with existing devices and interconnects.

quiz.question: 能否把研究文章中的退火條件直接當所有產品配方？
quiz.questionEn: Can an article’s anneal condition become the recipe for every product?
options: 不能，材料、堆疊與熱預算需分別核對。
能，只要研究和產品使用相同晶圓直徑。
能，所有既有互連對接合熱歷程的承受能力相同。
optionsEn: No; materials, stacks and thermal budgets need separate review.
Yes, if research and product wafer diameters match.
Yes; all existing interconnects tolerate the same bonding thermal history.
quiz.explanation: 不能，材料、堆疊與熱預算需分別核對。 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
quiz.explanationEn: No; materials, stacks and thermal budgets need separate review. Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

steps.title: 交叉判讀空洞、串鏈與接點電阻
steps.titleEn: Cross-check voids, chains and contact resistance
steps.objective: 避免單一測試掩蓋不同失效模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid allowing one test to conceal other failure modes.
steps.instruction: 製作四個紙上案例：外觀正常但串鏈開路、可導通但局部空洞、阻值偏高及各項一致。為每例選擇下一個能縮小原因範圍的量測，而非立即重工。
steps.instructionEn: Create paper cases with a normal appearance but open chain, conduction with local voids, elevated resistance and consistent results. Choose the next discriminating measurement before proposing rework.
steps.observation: 不同證據可能互補，也可能揭露取樣範圍不一致。
steps.observationEn: Different evidence can complement itself or reveal inconsistent sampling coverage.
steps.failure: 若把測到一條好串鏈擴大成整片合格，需回查測試覆蓋率。
steps.failureEn: If one good chain becomes a claim about the entire wafer, revisit coverage.
steps.check: 每個異常結論均指出測試覆蓋範圍及尚未排除的原因。
steps.checkEn: State test coverage and remaining possible causes for every abnormal conclusion.

knowledge.title: 多物理驗證
knowledge.text: 機械界面與電性路徑需要交叉驗證，才能縮小失效原因。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical interface and electrical-path evidence must be combined to narrow causes.

knowledge.title: 取樣覆蓋
knowledge.text: 局部良好結果不等於未量測區域已被證明良好。
knowledge.textEn: A good local result does not establish the condition of unmeasured regions.

quiz.question: 一條串鏈正常但附近影像有空洞，最佳解讀是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: One chain passes but nearby imaging shows a void. What is the best interpretation?
options: 串鏈導通已足以排除所有機械界面缺陷。
兩種測試覆蓋與失效敏感性不同，需交叉定位。
有局部空洞便可認定整片每個接點都開路。
optionsEn: Chain continuity rules out every mechanical-interface defect.
Coverage and failure sensitivity differ; correlate their locations.
One local void proves every wafer contact is open.
quiz.explanation: 兩種測試覆蓋與失效敏感性不同，需交叉定位。 機械界面與電性路徑需要交叉驗證，才能縮小失效原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coverage and failure sensitivity differ; correlate their locations. Mechanical interface and electrical-path evidence must be combined to narrow causes.

steps.title: 建立接合批次的可靠度與交接表
steps.objective: 將製程條件、初始結果與後續變化連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Link process conditions, initial results and later changes.
steps.instruction: 把配對識別、對位地圖、形貌、接合紀錄及初始電性放入一張交接表。再加入假設的應力前後結果，區分初始缺陷和隨時間出現的劣化。
steps.instructionEn: Combine pairing, overlay, topography, bond history and initial electrical results in a handoff sheet. Add hypothetical before-and-after stress results to distinguish initial defects from later degradation.
steps.observation: 初始可導通不代表經應力後仍維持相同表現。
steps.observationEn: Initial continuity does not guarantee unchanged behavior after stress.
steps.failure: 沒有初始基線便難以判斷變化；先補足基線與樣本對應。
steps.failureEn: Without a baseline, change is hard to judge; restore baseline and sample correspondence.
steps.check: 為放行、複查與後續可靠度驗證各列出條件，不宣稱教學模型已證明量產可靠度。
steps.checkEn: Define release, review and later reliability conditions without claiming that the teaching model proves production reliability.

knowledge.title: 基線比較
knowledge.text: 可靠度觀察需要把同一樣本的初始與後續證據連接。
knowledge.textEn: Reliability observations need a link between the same sample’s initial and later evidence.

knowledge.title: 工程交接
knowledge.text: 後段薄化、互連與測試需知道接合界面的限制與未解問題。
knowledge.textEn: Later thinning, interconnect and test operations need interface limits and unresolved issues.

quiz.question: 為何保留應力測試前的電性基線？
quiz.questionEn: Why retain electrical results from before a stress test?
options: 用基線直接代替所有應力後量測。
只比較不同批次的最終平均值，不追蹤同一樣本。
用來識別後續變化，而不只看最終數字。
optionsEn: Substitute the baseline for every post-stress measurement.
Compare only final averages from different lots without tracking the same sample.
To identify change rather than view only a final number.
quiz.explanation: 用來識別後續變化，而不只看最終數字。 可靠度觀察需要把同一樣本的初始與後續證據連接。
quiz.explanationEn: To identify change rather than view only a final number. Reliability observations need a link between the same sample’s initial and later evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied.
